notes.title: DARTHY development is on hold for a while
notes.notes:
So sorry to say DARTHY development is on hold while my son rests, he had a seizure and had to have emergency brain surgery to relieve pressure from blood in his brain.

He is doing very well but just needs rest. We won't know if the bleeding fully stopped for a couple of weeks as he has a ct scan.

Will update when my kids and i are able to work on DARTHY again.

We are lowering the price until we can start working again and have a big update to upload.

cheers 
Collin

notes.title: DARTHY Live on Early Access
notes.notes:
After almost a year of development we've finally made it here to STEAM :) We are just happy we have made it this far working on DARTHY together. The kids fingers are bleeding from play testing hahaha

If you have any questions or comments please do not hesitate to ask.

cheers,
Collin, Kaleb, & Jeya
